title: The second seam
description: A folded spring cloth remembers its wounds in softer connections. Opposing twists open its edge into several depths; copper marks new bonds paid from a finite construction stock.

params.description: A folded cloth opens under opposing twists. Its wounds are bridged by a finite stock of softer copper-colored connections, which carry new loads and sometimes tear again.
params.title: The second seam

simulation: Existing central-force BondNetwork with cyclic externally driven stretching, shearing and opposing grip rotation, irreversible tensile failure, and study-local delayed repair. Finite node repair stock funds new lower-stiffness bonds at their current separation; old damage and bond IDs are preserved. Repair stock is a normalized construction budget, not a calibrated mass model; node inertia stays fixed.
initialization: Deliberately curved, disordered layered lattice and weakened notch. All later positions and bond failures follow mechanical dynamics. No simulated optical feedback.
